text:
maya: Quick sync — celadon-3b-open onboarding. Canary started but perf profile for short-conversation latency is ~2.2x higher than the catalog baseline on A100. Also filing: legal asked about a non-commercial clause in the license, we need a quick decision so we can ship the model to hosted.
ron: Oof. Do we have the failing trace? I saw increased kernel stalls on the canary logs earlier.
alec: I pulled the canary logs into S3: s3://redwood-canary/celadon/1768888888/logs.tar.gz. Early hypothesis is mixed-precision fallback on the last attention block — looks like quant->fp fallback.
sophie: cc @legal-bot — legal, is the "non-commercial" restriction a hard blocker for hosted or is there an approved enterprise-only route?
legal-bot: Quick note: the license text flags "non-commercial" for model checkpoint C. We can allow Dedicated & Private deployment only; hosted API requires explicit waiver from upstream. Need intake ticket assigned to Legal Ops to request waiver.
maya: Thanks. For launch planning, two parallel tracks: (A) get Legal Ops the waiver request (owners: sophie + legal-bot), (B) fix perf/regression for canary (owners: ron + alec). Want final go/no-go in 48h.
ron: For perf: I can repro locally. Adding a small benchmark script to reproduce sequence length/beam shape. Will run on A100 and 3090 to check differences.
alec: Putting the quick test command here:
```
# minimal repro
python bench_infer.py --model celadon-3b-open --seq 128 --batch 4 --dtype q4_0 --device cuda
```
alec: If the q4 path triggers fp fallback, switch to `--dtype fp16` to compare.
sophie: Also observed embedding shape mismatch with our catalog embeddings schema — the embeddings endpoint returned 768 floats but docs expect 1024 for other models. Needs normalization or mapping.
devex: For catalog metadata, please confirm the canonical embedding dimension before launch. If we publish 768, we'll need a migration note for downstream consumers.
ron: I ran the local bench, saw a 2.1x higher p95 token latency on A100 vs expected. Traces point to a fused kernel not being picked due to `rotary_dim` mismatch in the tokenizer config.
maya: Action items so far:
- [ ] Legal waiver request (owners: sophie, legal-bot) — target: 24h
- [ ] Perf root-cause RCA + patch (owners: ron, alec) — target: 24-48h
- [ ] Embedding schema reconcile or adapter (owners: devex, maya) — target: 48h
- [ ] Canary re-run on Dedicated pool and Hosted staging (owners: eng-ml oncall) — after patch
ron: I'll open a PR with the quick fix (likely a small runtime selector change) and assign to @alec for review. PR will include bench numbers pre/post.
alec: I'll prioritize review; if green, let's promote the patch to staging and run the full sweep: `./scripts/sweep_canary.sh celadon-3b-open`.
ci-bot: Canary pipeline report: `canary/celadon-3b-open` — failure, step `inference-smoke` (exit 1). Logs uploaded to build/1768888888/artifacts.
sophie: If legal says Hosted is blocked, we should still aim to onboard celadon to Dedicated & Private so customers with reserved capacity can use it. That reduces immediate product impact.
maya: Agree. Let's decouple the release lanes: mark hosted=false in the catalog entry until legal returns. We can publish model card + perf profiles for Dedicated/Private.
devex: Small request: add a note in the catalog QA checklist about tokenizer rotary_dim checks and embedding dims so future onboardings don't hit this.
ron: I'll paste the failing stack snippet here for visibility:
```
RuntimeError: mixed-precision fallback at attention_kernel.cpp:224 — unsupported rotary_dim=64 for quantized kernel
```
sophie: Thanks. I'll draft the waiver request template and ping Legal Ops now.
maya: Will follow up with a short status update in #product after we have legal clarity. If anyone hits blockers or needs staging access, reply here or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
